form.mustChange: The user must choose a new password on first sign-in
form.help: Creating a user also creates their OpenRouter key “blockingbear-username”, with the spending cap you set (reset at the chosen interval, at midnight UTC). Limits and usage are managed from the Costs page.

toast.createdNoKey: User created, but without an OpenRouter key
toast.createdNoKeyHint: {{error}} — try again with the key icon.
toast.deletedKeyKept: User deleted, but the OpenRouter key was not revoked

confirmDelete.title: Delete this user?
confirmDelete.text: The account “{{user}}” will no longer be able to sign in; its OpenRouter key is revoked.
confirmDelete.content: Everything the account created is deleted as well — projects: {{projects}}, chats: {{chats}}, along with their files, attachments and personal settings. This cannot be undone.

confirmRotate.title: Regenerate the key?
confirmRotate.text: “{{user}}”'s current key is revoked immediately and replaced by a new one: any requests still running with the old key will fail. Usage history is kept.
